en: Dependent on a state with root that is wholesome, a state without root and not wholesome arises by way of root condition. Under root: one ... pe ... under non-disappearance: one.

Dependent on a state with root that is unwholesome, a state without root and not unwholesome arises by way of root condition ... Under root: three, under predominance: one ... pe ... under non-disappearance: three.

Dependent on a state without root that is indeterminate, a state without root and not indeterminate arises by way of root condition. Under root: one, under object: three, under predominance: one ... pe ... under non-disappearance: three.
